isolation: Prediction container mounts source-only raster, code read-only and initially empty output. No original PDF, reference rasters, host home, Docker socket, or network. Coordinator has access to original; not a blinded human study.
guards: Unchanged V3 full guard in memory and after serialization. Any failure blocks usability. Failed diagnostics may be frozen, never waived.
track_a: Unchanged 1.9c source ownership + COMPLETE-only 1.8 masks. No handoff tuning, no 1.10, no editing.
track_b: B1 absolute staff coordinate analysis only; preserve original x/staff/system/measure geometry. Separate detected center, corrected semantic coordinate, absolute target coordinate, UNDEFINED replacement anchor. No B2.

evaluation.automated_note_correspondence: Exact unique semantic identity candidates only; unmatched is UNKNOWN. Report raw counts, no accuracy denominator.
evaluation.visual_spot_check_fixed_before_predictio: Opening key signature, first three pitched notes, first two chord symbols in printed reading order on each page. Single coordinator visual check, not independent human ground truth.
evaluation.geometry: Graph/detector correspondence is candidate evidence only; no detector output is verified physical truth. No musically correct result penalized for engraving layout differences.
